name: magpylib-studio-vscode
description: VS Code extension shell for the magpylib-studio headless engine.

commands.title: magpylib Studio: Select Object in Studio

magpylib-studio.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter used to run the magpylib-studio engine. Empty = auto-detect (.venv next to the workspace, then python3).

languageModelTools.name: magpylib-studio_listObjects
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the objects in the current magpylib Studio scene. Returns an array of {id, type, label}. Call this first to discover object ids before editing styles.

languageModelTools.name: magpylib-studio_getSchema
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the JSON Schema describing every editable style property of one magpylib scene object (valid dotted paths, types, allowed values). Use it to find the correct path/value before calling the apply edit tool.

object_id.description: Id of the scene object, as returned by the list objects tool.

languageModelTools.name: magpylib-studio_addObject
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Add a new object to the magpylib Studio scene. 'type' is a dotted magpylib class path like 'magnet.Cuboid', 'magnet.Cylinder', 'magnet.Sphere', 'current.Circle' or 'Sensor'. 'params' are the constructor kwargs (e.g. polarization, dimension/diameter, position); 'style' maps dotted style paths to values. On failure the result contains the constructor/validation error - fix and retry. Note: on magnets the default magnetization coloring masks the base 'color' style - for a visible solid color also include 'magnetization.mode': 'arrow'.

object_id.description: New unique id for the object (used as the variable name in generated scripts).

style.description: Optional style, dotted paths to values, e.g. {"label": "Ball", "color": "green"}.

languageModelTools.name: magpylib-studio_removeObject
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Remove one object from the magpylib Studio scene by id.

object_id.description: Id of the scene object to remove, as returned by the list objects tool.

languageModelTools.name: magpylib-studio_setParam
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Set a constructor parameter of a magpylib scene object - position, dimension, diameter, polarization, ... Use this to move or resize objects (style edits use the apply edit tool instead). On failure the result contains the error - fix and retry.

object_id.description: Id of the scene object, as returned by the list objects tool.

languageModelTools.name: magpylib-studio_applyEdit
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Set one style property on a magpylib scene object using a dotted path (e.g. 'color', 'magnetization.arrow.width'). The value is validated by magpylib; on failure the result contains the validation error - correct the path/value and retry. The Studio view refreshes automatically. Note: on magnets, magnetization coloring (a blue-white-red gradient) is shown by default and masks the base 'color' - when the user wants a visible solid color, also set 'magnetization.mode' to 'arrow' (or 'magnetization.show' to false).

object_id.description: Id of the scene object, as returned by the list objects tool.

value.description: New value for the property (string, number, boolean, or array as required by the schema).
